csv_project_name: Design Build for Ground Based Strategic Deterrent
csv_agency: USACE-US Army Corp of Engineers-Omaha District, NE
csv_scope_of_work: Two Phase Design-Build (DB) Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) for Construction of the Ground Based Strategic Deterrent (GBSD) Utility Corridor (UC) at Francis E. Warren Air Force Base (FEW AFB). The scope of this request for proposal (RFP) includes all work required to complete construction of the GBSD UC at FEW AFB, WY. The construction limits will extend between 1,500 and 2,500 miles, from FEW AFB across southeast Wyoming and throughout both northeast Colorado and western Nebraska

title: Design-Build for Ground Based Strategic Deterrent
short_description: Design-build MATOC for a large military utility corridor across Wyoming, Colorado, and Nebraska.
project_location: Francis E. Warren Air Force Base, Wyoming, with corridor works across southeast Wyoming, northeast Colorado, and western Nebraska, USA.
project_scope: Two-phase design-build multiple award task order contract for construction of the Ground Based Strategic Deterrent utility corridor at Francis E. Warren Air Force Base. The construction limits extend approximately 1,500 to 2,500 miles from the base across southeast Wyoming and throughout northeast Colorado and western Nebraska. The notice indicates large-scale corridor civil works and associated rehabilitation/refurbishment within a military infrastructure context.
services: Design-build services under a MATOC, including construction and associated civil engineering, programming, interior design/space planning, and rehabilitation/refurbishment.
relevance_explanation:
- Very large infrastructure program, but the described scope is a military utility corridor rather than a bridge, roof, stadium, or special structural project.
- Category is general building/civil corridor work with no clear indication of architecturally demanding or lightweight structural design.
- Design-build format can include planning input, but the notice does not specify structural engineering tasks aligned with sbp's core strengths.
- Military base project reduces strategic fit for sbp compared with cultural, bridge, sports, or special structure opportunities.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning fee is stated. The notice is for a two-phase design-build MATOC with total construction cost of 500,000,000 USD, but no separate design or engineering fee allocation is provided.
references_qualifications: Design-build multiple award task order contract; specific bidder reference requirements are not stated in the provided source.
